provenance.notes: Filename frames the design as an Apple interview hard. Code is the O(n)/O(1) two-pointer march.

examples.why: Each valley is bounded by the min of its two walls.

invariants: water at i equals max(0, min(left_max[i], right_max[i]) - height[i])

narrative.asked: Given a 1D elevation map, how much water stays after rain?

knowledge_extract.what_must_be_known: At index i, only the minimum of the two side-maxima matters.
knowledge_extract.naive: For each i, scan left and right for maxima.
knowledge_extract.insight: Always advance the side whose current height is smaller; that running max is the binding constraint.

steps.action: l, r = 0, n-1; lmax = rmax = 0; ans = 0
if height[l] <= height[r], water is limited by lmax; else by rmax
update side-max, add trapped units, move that pointer inward

algorithmic_design.why_this_not_that: Prefix arrays are the same invariant with O(n) extra memory.
